newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close flat, await CA decision.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close flat, await CA decision.

text.p: 1325 GMT - Austrian shares closed virtually unchanged on Wednesday, with selective buying mainly in cyclical stocks, traders said. Buyers seen hesitant ahead of sale of privatisation candidate Creditanstalt-Bankverein.
* ATX index up 0.19 points or 0.02 percent at 1,137.28
* January ATX future up 1.5 points at 1,136.5
* Leading gainer Austro Mikro Systeme, up 3.52 percent at 876 schillings
* Leading decliner Bank Austria preferred shares, down 1.65 percent at 398.3 schillings
* Vienna Bourse index down 0.05 points or 0.01 percent at 427.63 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
